reference: util-linux mkswap on identical small private regular files for raw CLI/status/tree parity; independent Linux swap v1 encoder for separate fixed-output/header contracts. No raw device, swap activation or kernel change. The deliberate Python exec adapter invokes the installed util-linux executable at /usr/sbin/mkswap because the harness reference PATH omits sbin.
coverage: Fixed 4096-byte page, UUID, label, full header and untouched tail.
Explicit size, minimum size, UUID/label boundaries, oversize force and option/dash-path parsing.
exclusions: Raw devices and activation require a future disposable VM or fail-closed ioctl/swapon mock.
No undersized-page allocations, large inputs, hardware or kernel changes are tested.

Only -p4096, fixed UUIDs and bounded ordinary zero-filled regular files are executed. Page-size allocation bounds, overflow guards and other defensive geometry branches are reviewed in source without undersized-page or stress execution.

Supported page sizes are bounded powers of two from 2048 to 65536; other page sizes, nondecimal size suffixes, random UUID entropy failures, I/O fault injection, ownership and device geometry are not qualified.
Util-linux diagnostics are checked for presence where specified, not byte identity; stdout, status and image bytes are never normalized.

cases.purpose: Verify the Bash metadata contract that the statically registered mkswap command is a builtin, independent of whether its operation is invoked.
cases.script: type -t mkswap

cases.purpose: Check Bash short help against the documented mkswap command synopsis.
cases.script: help -s mkswap
cases.stdout: mkswap: mkswap [-L label] [-U uuid] [-p pagesize] [-f] device|file [size]

cases.purpose: Check that Bash help retains the documented format and limits without running the mkswap loadable operation.
cases.script:
doc=$(help mkswap)
if [[ $doc == *'Set up a Linux swap area.'* && $doc == *'volume label (truncated to 15 bytes, with warning)'* && $doc == *'use this UUID'* && $doc == *'page size in bytes'* && $doc == *'optional size in 1024-byte blocks'* && $doc == *'SWAPSPACE2'* && $doc == *'at least 10 pages'* ]]; then
  printf 'documented mkswap contract present\n'
else
  exit 1
fi

cases.purpose: Independent complete Linux swap v1 image encoder, untouched tail and mode checks; expected raw presentation explicitly updated to the util-linux-compatible interface.
